description: This file handles HTTP request validation, body reading, and context resolution for MCP requests in a server environment.

methods.name: resolveScopedSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the session key, defaulting to main session key if undefined or 'main'.

methods.name: validateMcpLoopbackRequest
methods.description: Validates incoming MCP HTTP requests for correct method, URL, headers, and authorization.

methods.name: readMcpHttpBody
methods.description: Reads and concatenates the request body, enforcing a maximum size.

methods.name: resolveMcpRequestContext
methods.description: Constructs the MCP request context from request headers and configuration.
